statement: The hash a frame is acked and chained by is the hash of the bytes both sides sign, and those bytes bind the author side. Until then the TS hash is provisionalFrameHash, a stand-in that covers the author, parent and every field of every tx and nothing more; it must not be signed, sent on the wire or stored.
source: coordinator decision 10-01 on A3 (provisional frame hash)

layers.arrival: owed: spec thread (an Arrival page for the bytes both sides sign)

layers.contract: n/a: frame hashes are off-chain; the chain verifies proof signatures, not frame hashes
